name: Stitchy (Personal Stylist)
description: Arrives at 6am with the forecast and an outfit assembled from clothes you already own, photos attached, plus the occasional Freestyle pick when something genuinely warrants it. Built around a Stitch Fix wardrobe, so it needs your purchase history to say anything useful.

official.title: Stitchy by Mitchell
official.description: A Stitch Fix stylist. Morning briefing at 6am with the day's weather, an outfit from bought items (photos included), and only the really good Freestyle...
